your_book:
Tuesday was a broad-based down day for Jaleel's book, with the portfolio's overall unrealized loss deepening to –2.21%. Only two holdings finished in the green: Broadcom (+1.59%) and Adobe (+0.81%), both smaller positions. The damage was led by Equifax (–3.66%), Lululemon (–3.61%), and Rocket Lab (–3.44%) — three names already carrying meaningful unrealized losses of –18.3%, –24.2%, and –11.0% respectively. Lululemon's slide is particularly pointed: a guidance cut (Americas comps –5% for five straight quarters, tariff pressure, China stalled) is an active thesis-breaker, yet the position still carries a STRONG BUY verdict. That gap between the framework's conviction and the deteriorating fundamentals is the clearest tension in the book right now. Defense stocks broadly entered bear-market territory, dragging Rocket Lab lower, which compounded an already-troubled position rated AVOID.

The two largest weights — NVIDIA (12.0%) and Abbott (9.9%) — held relatively steady, down just –0.74% and –0.09% respectively. AstraZeneca's –1.14% dip came despite the headline that it committed $2 billion to Summit Therapeutics' cancer drug ivonescimab, a pipeline-building move that supports the long-term thesis even if it weighed on shares today. Boston Scientific (–0.88%) and Zoetis (–1.62%) both sit at –10.8% unrealized losses with active guidance-cut risk flags, meaning the market has already repriced them once and the thesis needs to hold on execution alone.

The drift zone to watch: BSX and ZTS are both rated STRONG BUY while sitting on double-digit unrealized losses and elevated risk flags with upcoming earnings. NBIX (–1.41% today, –15.1% unrealized, STRONG BUY) and NVS (–0.93%, –10.6%) add to the pharma cluster's drag, where drug-pricing policy headwinds remain unresolved. Equifax's –3.66% single-session move on a small weight is worth monitoring — one day doesn't rewrite a thesis, but a –18.3% unrealized loss on an 81.1 QARP name deserves a closer look at what's driving persistent underperformance.

attention.headline: Thesis vs. reality gap is widest in the book
attention.note: A –24.2% unrealized loss, an active guidance-cut flag (Americas comps –5% for five consecutive quarters, tariff margin erosion, China stalled), and today's –3.61% session loss together make the STRONG BUY verdict the most challenged call in the portfolio — next catalyst isn't until Dec 9, leaving the position exposed for months.

attention.headline: AVOID-rated position deepens losses as defense enters bear market
attention.note: Rocket Lab is the only holding explicitly rated AVOID, carries a –11.0% unrealized loss, dropped –3.44% today amid a record losing streak for defense stocks, and has the lowest QARP score (38.1) in the book — the case for continued holding is not visible in the data provided.

attention.headline: Guidance slashed; Oct 28 earnings are a near-term verdict on the thesis
attention.note: FY26 growth was cut from 10.5% to 7–8.5%, management guided flat through Q3, and the position sits at –10.8% unrealized — Oct 28 earnings will either validate the STRONG BUY conviction or confirm the market's skepticism.

attention.headline: –3.66% single-session drop on a –18.3% unrealized loss warrants scrutiny
attention.note: Equifax has the second-deepest unrealized loss in the book and one of the highest QARP scores (81.1), suggesting a quality name persistently mispriced — but the gap between framework conviction and price action needs a clear explanation before it can be dismissed as noise.
